details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:final line `exit 0` (line 102) | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The helper exits successfully after restore validation or credential operations fail.
  WHY: The workflow cannot detect a rejected or incomplete restore and may continue to later editor, commit, or push steps with credentials or destinations that were not safely validated.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:hide path, `if ! : > "${marker}"; then ... exit 0; fi` | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Hide exits successfully when marker file creation fails.
  WHY: The editor can launch with credentials still in `.git/config` because the workflow cannot detect that credential isolation did not run.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:hide path, lines 38-52 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: Hide logs credential removal failures and continues instead of failing.
  WHY: The editor can launch while credentials remain in `.git/config`, despite the workflow receiving a successful exit status.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:restore path, lines 59-60 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Restore exits successfully when `GH_TOKEN` is missing.
  WHY: Subsequent Git operations proceed without credentials and the caller receives no failure signal.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:restore path, lines 62-64 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: Restore exits silently when the marker file is missing instead of reporting `reason=marker_missing`.
  WHY: The caller cannot distinguish an intentional no-op from a missing or deleted marker, contrary to the diagnostic expected by the tests.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:hide path, lines 24-27 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Hide exits successfully when a pre-existing unrestored marker exists.
  WHY: A stale credential state can be concealed, and repeated hide may overwrite the record of which credentials were removed.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:restore path, lines 72-77 (origin case) | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Restore accepts any `https://github.com/` origin without verifying that its repository slug matches the trusted workflow repository.
  WHY: An editor can change the origin to an attacker-controlled GitHub repository and receive the restored `GH_TOKEN`.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:hide path, no check for `remote.origin.pushurl` or `url.*.pushInsteadOf`; restore path, origin case, no push URL validation | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The helper does not inspect or reject explicit push URLs or `pushInsteadOf` rewrites.
  WHY: A push can send restored credentials to an attacker-controlled destination while the fetch origin remains valid.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:restore path, origin case, reads `remote get-url origin` once | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Restore does not reject multiple `remote.origin.url` values.
  WHY: It can validate one URL and inject credentials while an attacker-controlled secondary origin remains configured.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:restore path, extraheader case lines 79-87 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Restore accepts untrusted GitHub-scoped extraheaders and restores recorded extraheaders without scoping them to the verified origin.
  WHY: A generic or attacker-scoped extraheader can apply the token to Git operations outside the trusted repository.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:restore path, extraheader case lines 79-87 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The extraheader case glob does not match repository-scoped keys containing additional `/` path segments.
  WHY: A repository-scoped extraheader such as `http.https://github.com/owner/repo.extraheader` is not matched by the marker-key pattern.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:restore path, lines 65-96 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Restore injects credentials into each checkout before validating all checkouts.
  WHY: A later checkout can fail validation after credentials have already been injected into an earlier checkout.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:hide path, lines 33; `repo_git "${repo}" rev-parse --git-dir` check (line 33) | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The checkout check uses Git’s upward directory discovery, so a nested non-checkout can resolve to its parent repository.
  WHY: Hide can strip credentials from the parent repository instead of skipping the nested non-checkout. Severity disagreement: openai_gpt-6-luna rated this MAJOR; the highest reported severity is BLOCKER.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:hide path, after the for repo loop, no check for GITHUB_REPOSITORY | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Hide does not verify `GITHUB_REPOSITORY` before modifying Git configuration.
  WHY: Without trusted repository identity, the helper cannot distinguish its intended checkout from another repository with a GitHub origin.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:hide path, strips credentials from hardcoded repository paths | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: Hide modifies Git configuration at hardcoded candidate paths without verifying that each is a trusted workflow checkout.
  WHY: An attacker-created directory under the workspace with a GitHub origin could receive credentials during restore.
- tests/test_heal_evidence_editor_isolation.py:14 failing tests | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The CI job fails with 14 assertion failures in the editor isolation test file.
  WHY: The tests assert security properties the implementation does not provide, and the reported PR verification claim is contradicted by the failing CI output.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:lines 2878, 2893 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The workflow relies on the credential helper’s exit code to halt after credential validation failures, but the helper returns success.
  WHY: The workflow can continue to the subsequent push after the helper fails to validate credentials or destinations.
- tests/test_audit_plans_command.py:Lines 15-16 (if not COMMAND.exists(): COMMAND = TEMPLATE_COMMAND) | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  PROBLEM: The fallback assigns `COMMAND` to `TEMPLATE_COMMAND` when the root command file is missing.
  WHY: The template parity test then compares the template file to itself and can conceal drift or a missing root command.
- tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py:Lines 29-34 (template fallbacks for GUARD_PATH, SETTINGS_PATH, and TEMPLATE_CLAUDE_MD) | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  PROBLEM: The fallbacks assign root-path variables to template counterparts when the root files are missing.
  WHY: The parity assertions can compare template files to themselves and stop enforcing parity between root and template files.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "The credential helper rejects failed hides/restores and restores auth only when the origin still names the workflow's original repository (or its trusted support checkout) and its push URL agrees, not an editor-changed GitHub destination; generic GitHub extraheaders are restored scoped to the verified origin only."
  expected_change_site: scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh — hide and restore paths
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh does not validate trusted repository identity, origin slug, push URLs or rewrites, extraheader scope, multiple origin URLs, or all checkouts before token injection; hide/restore failure paths return success; CI reports 14 failing assertions in tests/test_heal_evidence_editor_isolation.py.
- requirement: "Implement runs with heal evidence also pin the issue/plan file allowlist before the editor and block out-of-scope commits even when the normal guard or per-run override is disabled."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/implement.yml preflight + commit steps, scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: The scope-lock wiring is present, but a failed credential restore can still return success and allow the editor to run; the 14 CI failures block verification of the scope-lock behavior in the same CI job.
- requirement: "Every other test touching the changed workflows ran on this branch and on a clean main side by side, with identical results."
  expected_change_site: The tests-heal-plan-and-validation CI job
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: CI reports tests-heal-plan-and-validation failing with 14 assertions in tests/test_heal_evidence_editor_isolation.py, contradicting the stated verification claim.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
